metadata.description:
This mythical POAP celebrates your partybid donation supporting Ukraine cause after Putin's unjustified invasion. 

🇺🇦 2250 ETH / $6.75M USD CONTRIBUTED TO THE 

Thank you to all who supported our project 🙏
You may still donate ETH directly to ukrainedao.eth

Artwork by : Twitter :@thevictorjimmy // IG: @thevictorjimmy // Discord: thevictorjimmy#8814

Quote : "The two fingers illustration is representative of the universal friendly sign for peace.
In the background, we have the colours of the Ukrainian flag (yellow and blue) boldly displayed as well as the words "PEACE" faintly inscribed
The art signifies that everyone can lend their support towards ensuring peace in the nation of Ukraine, regardless of race, religion, gender, social class, etc..."
metadata.name: UKRAINIAN FLAG NFT 🇺🇦 by @Ukraine_DAO Donor - 3.22
